title: In JetBrains Junie GitHub Action before 1.8.0 code execution with workflow credentials was possible via fork updates…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains Junie GitHub Action versions prior to 1.8.0 allows code execution with workflow credentials via fork updates. This flaw could enable unauthorized code execution in the context of the GitHub Actions workflow, potentially leading to high-impact confidentiality and integrity breaches.
